notes.title: 1.0.4 - UPDATE Inside VR Menu and bug fixes!
notes.content:
Hello everyone,

in this update, we added an inside VR Menu! Some of you asked that and here it is!

Also, we fixed some bug fixes and performance updates! The game should run faster on every computer! 

The car amount slider reduced the number of cars, but not the number of NPC ships. So in slow computers, the slider, even in zero position, was losing some frames. Now it is fixed!

Enjoy it!

notes.title: 1.0.3 - UPDATE Customize VR controllers
notes.content:
Hi guys,

some of you are having trouble with our VR controller's choices. 

We fly the ship using inputs that are optimized for the experience we thought was ideal. But we are a small group of people and we really think you will have the best options for controllers! So, configure it as you like!

Just drag and drop the action to the correspondent input and you will be fine :)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42287685/0dcbc6dfed9810031872ce6e0018a1681bba5955.jpg[/img]

Have a nice flight!

notes.title: 1.0.2 - UPDATE Booster of ships and recharging stations!
notes.content:
Hi guys,

this weekend we worked very hard to fix and add some of your demands! 

In this build, you are able to fly 5 times faster than before! But it consumes energy that needs to be recharged!

There are some recharging stations around the map, it shouldn't be hard to find them using the ship's GPS.

Stop for a few seconds and you will have a dramatic increase in ship speed! 

Hope you guys enjoy that update!

Have a nice week and a nice flight!

notes.title: Version 1.0.1 - More cars and adjust rain.
notes.content:
Hi guys!

Thank you all for your downloads, reviews, and feedback! 

In version 1.0.1 we added:
- slider to control car quantity. Now you can go from just a few to a LOT of cars.
It will impact performance, so if you have a strong config on your PC, try to add more cars to the game!
If you want more performance on slower computers, slide to zero and be happy!

- slider to control rain intensity
Some of you want to control rain intensity, we agree that this is a good feature! So, here you go!

It does not change performance, but changes your visibility, especially in VR devices with lower resolution.

Have a nice flight!

notes.title: We are here!
notes.content:
Hello and thank you from the Cyber Car Industries Team!

We're absolutely amazed by the support and interest showed by people from the Steam community! Many of you with interesting questions and wishes! We hope in the near future to be able to fill all your needs!

The game is FREE and will be FREE forever. We just wanted to share our love for VR experiences and for Cyberpunk's "vibe" with Cyber Car.

Of course, there is still much to do and much to explore! And we will be working on all that! 

We missed the release date on May 5, sorry for that! But we are ready!

Thank you for your patience and for playing our game! 

Any questions, you can send me a direct e-mail (brunoasdfgh@gmail.com) or to support@thetisgames.com or open a discussion on Steam! I will be reading and answering everyone!

Thank you again, and have a nice flight!

notes.title: Launch date updated to May 12 of 2022! Without further delay! Are you ready?
notes.content:
Thanks to everyone who gave the wishlist and the wait is over! just a couple more days!

Development and testing are complete for release. We hope to deliver a well-finished product to you!

Our efforts in the last few days were to make more controls and devices compatible with VR. Including the Oculus QUEST 2 [i](NOTE: This is not a Quest 2 native app, so you will need to install SteamVR to play using Air Link). [/i]

The game is a sandbox, where flying and enjoying the scenery is all you can do for now. Despite being simple, it's pretty amazing! We hope you like it!

In the future, we will create missions, more ships, and more interactions, but we want to share this VR experience with you as soon as we can! 

 May 12, 2022, is the date!
